title: tdh.util.adsr~
description: `tdh.util.adsr~` is a multi-segment ADSR envelope generator for shaping values, such as multiplying an oscillator by its output to contour amplitude. A gate value greater than 0 starts the attack and decay stages and holds the sustain level, while 0 triggers the release to 0; attack, decay, and release times are specified in milliseconds.
